title: New York Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & How to File
rank_math_title: New York Small Claims Court (2026): Limits by Court & Fees
rank_math_description: New York small claims in 2026: $10,000 in NYC, $5,000 city/district, $3,000 town courts, $15-$20 fees, commercial claims for businesses and appeal rules.
pdf_outline: Which court? NYC Civil ($10,000) / City & District ($5,000) / Town & Village ($3,000)

Checklist: demand letter -> right court -> exact defendant name -> file ($15/$20) -> clerk mails notice -> evidence (2 itemized estimates or paid receipt) -> judge vs arbitrator -> 30-day appeal window -> collection (information subpoena, income execution, 1812 treble damages)
Box: businesses use commercial claims ($25 + mailing, 5/month, consumer demand letter 10-180 days)
